Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Expensive shipping, not so great quality, return is complicated, customer service is slow :(((](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a13556053e77876cad05b7d)
I ordered two pillows and paid $20 for shipping!! Both came with the sewn labels cut off which made me think they were used. I have ordered multiple times from Lulu & Georgia and my overall experience is that items look better on their website than in person. And shipping fees are ridiculous. Now to the return process, the website doesn’t let me create one return label for both pillows! They have to be processed separately! So confusing as they both came in one package and now I have to return them in two separate packages? I sent them an email and still waiting for a response. I’m not sure I will be back shopping there. So disappointing.

May 19, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 26, 2026

Hi Sherry,

Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced with your order. Our Customer Support team is actively working on a resolution, and will be in touch with you shortly. We appreciate your patience during this time.

Lulu and Georgia
